about.title: About Hangar
about.paragraph1: Hangar is a climbing playground by Adam Ondra: a climbing centre dedicated entirely to bouldering, created with one of the world's best climbers. In 2019 we kicked off a new era of modern bouldering in the Czech Republic in Brno, and today you'll find us in Ostrava too.
about.paragraph2: Over 300 boulders from total beginner to 8A, and training zones with Moonboards, spray walls and, in Ostrava, a Kilterboard. Our setters add new boulders every week, so nothing gets old.
about.paragraph3: Most of all, Hangar is a community. Every month we climb the Hangar Challenge, young competitors grow up in the Hangar Rockets club, and after climbing we meet over specialty coffee at our Cafe Bar.

events.title: Events & activities
events.line1: Climbing courses for kids and adults, fitness classes, birthday parties and day camps.
events.line2: And every month, the Hangar Challenge: 30 new boulders and a competition for everyone.

visit.title: Visit us
visit.line1: First time at Hangar? Register online beforehand and save time for yourself and our bar staff.
visit.line2: We're open every day except Christmas Eve, and your entry is valid all day. We'll lend you climbing shoes.

challenge.text: Every month, 30 new boulders and a competition for everyone, from hobby climbers to the elite. You log your own results in the TopLogger app.

ChallengePage.title: Hangar Challenge
ChallengePage.subtitle: A competition for everyone. Every month: 30 boulders, loads of fun and pushing your limits.

what.title: What is the Hangar Challenge?
what.text: Every month we set 30 boulders marked with numbered Hangar Challenge cards, 1 to 30. They get harder as you go, so start at number one to warm up. There are three categories, Hobby, Sport and Elite, and the goal is to top as many boulders as possible in as few attempts as possible. It's all about fair play: everyone logs their own results. In Brno the Challenge runs from the first to the last day of the month; in Ostrava, from the 15th to the 15th of the following month.
what.challenger: Challenger 2026 is a bouldering competition series where gravity loses its grip! Twice a year at each branch we climb the Challenge in competition mode: from 17:00 to 20:30, with results on the spot and much bigger prizes. Dates: Ostrava 20 March and 18 September, Brno 30 April and 27 October. At the end of the year we crown the King and Queen of the Challenger.

steps.step1: Download the TopLogger app and find your Hangar.
steps.step2: Under Competitions, pick Hangar Challenge and tap Register.
steps.step3: Climb boulders 1 to 30 and log every attempt (Try), every send (Top) and every Flash.
steps.step4: The best man and woman in each category win a free entry and a block of chalk.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.paragraph1: Personal data is processed by the operators of each branch: VerticalBlock s.r.o. (Hangar Brno) and CLIMBING GYM s.r.o. (Hangar Ostrava), both registered at U Soudu 6200/19, 708 00 Ostrava.
PrivacyPage.paragraph2: The full privacy policy will be added here after legal review. Until then, the GDPR documents published on hangarbrno.cz and hangarostrava.cz apply.

CookiePage.paragraph2: Once analytics are added, you'll find an overview of all cookies and your consent settings here.

VisitorRulesPage.title: Visitor Rules
VisitorRulesPage.paragraph1: Every visitor must read the visitor rules; you confirm you agree to them when you register. Each branch has its own visitor rules.
VisitorRulesPage.paragraph2: The key points: children under 13 only under constant adult supervision, teens aged 13 to 18 need a legal guardian's consent, and no barefoot climbing. You'll find the full rules under Documents on each branch's page.
